honest_c3.title: Mid-flight v1.0.0 → v1.1.0 transition required mid-writing pivot
honest_c3.detail: First 3 docs (v1_0_0, eeg_manifest, core_manifest) were initially written assuming v1.0.0 flat-layout reality. They landed accidentally inside eeg/docs/ai-native/ because the 'extend' BG ran the eeg/ subdir reorg between my mkdir and my first Write call. After detection I moved them to docs/ai-native/ at root and rewrote content for v1.1.0 dual-subsystem reality. v1.0.0 spinoff doc retains its name (v1_0_0_spinoff_*) as a historical handoff record but its body now documents the v1.0->v1.1 same-day transition.

honest_c3.title: Doc package describes verb routing for 30 of 98 dispatchable hexa files
honest_c3.detail: bin/hexa-brain exposes 16 eeg verbs + 14 core verbs = 30 routed verbs. The eeg subsystem has ~63 hexa files (30 eeg/*.hexa + 33 protocols/) and core has 68 files. Total ~131 hexa files in the package; 30 are first-class dispatcher targets. The remaining ~101 are reachable only via direct hexa run. The CLI design doc C3 #4 documents this gap; v1.2 expansion is a stated todo.

honest_c3.title: No CI runs the doc package's claimed invariants
honest_c3.detail: Each manifest's §3 'Public API surface' table claims dispatcher routing maps to specific files. There is no aggregate CI that verifies these mappings stay aligned with bin/hexa-brain after future edits. A v1.x lint target could parse the manifest tables + grep the dispatcher's case statements; not present in v1.1.0.

honest_c3.title: Anima-side doc is the only forward-pointer; no automated lint enforces it
honest_c3.detail: If a future anima cleanup deletes anima/docs/ai-native/hexa_brain_consumer_cross_link_2026_05_04.ai.md, anima readers lose the only in-tree pointer to hexa-brain. Mitigation: this verdict + the hexa-brain side cross-link both reference the anima-side path; recovery is possible by anyone reading either side.

honest_c3.title: Doc package does not yet land a git commit
honest_c3.detail: These 6 ai-native docs (hexa-brain) + 1 anima cross-link land as new files in working trees but the BG that ran me does not git commit. Per spec 'DO commit on hexa-brain repo (additive — these are NEW files in v1.x)' — that hexa-brain commit is the next step (next BG in the chain or human follow-up). Anima side per spec is intentionally NOT committed on main.

honest_c3.title: Wait-loop strategy was naive; recovered by reactive replan
honest_c3.detail: Spec wait condition was 'eeg/ + core/ exist as directories'. Both existed at t=0 (empty/partial scaffold) but were not yet populated. My poll counted directory-emptiness as 'not done', but by the time I detected progress, the v1.1.0 reorg had already landed in working tree. Killed wait loop and pivoted to documenting actual v1.1.0 state. Lesson: presence of named directories is not equivalent to completion of a populating BG; future BGs should poll on file-count or specific marker files, not directory existence.
